movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Storing Passwords in a Recoverable Format Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a storing passwords in a recoverable format vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to gain DCA user privileges by accessing a credential file for the DCA user on the filesystem as a low-privileged user.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for local privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability that can allow a malicious app to bypass signature validation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Splunk Enterprise Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Marimo Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiClient EMS SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: React Native Community CLI OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: React Native Community CLI contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated network attackers to send POST requests to the Metro Development Server and run arbitrary executables via a vulnerable endpoint exposed by the server. On Windows, attackers can also execute arbitrary shell commands with fully controlled arguments.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker with Site Owner privileges to execute code remotely.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect component contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user operating within the backup infrastructure network perimeter to obtain encrypted credentials stored in the configuration database. This may lead to an attacker gaining access to the backup infrastructure hosts.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Data Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Service Appliance component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows remote code execution due to incorrect data validation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence Server Pre-Authorization Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Affected versions of Atlassian Confluence Server allow remote attackers to view restricted resources via a pre-authorization arbitrary file read vulnerability in the /s/ endpoint.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix ShareFile Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Improper Access Control in Citrix ShareFile storage zones controller may allow an unauthenticated attacker to remotely compromise the storage zones controller.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe BlazeDS Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe BlazeDS, which is utilized in LifeCycle and Coldfusion, contains a vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the scripting engine handles objects in memory in Internet Explorer

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: VMware Server Side Request Forgery in vRealize Operations Manager API
movers24h.shortDescription: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in vRealize Operations Manager API prior to 8.4 may allow a malicious actor with network access to the vRealize Operations Manager API to perform a SSRF attack to steal administrative credentials.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Windows when the Win32k component fails to properly handle objects in memory, aka 'Win32k EoP.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Improper Authorization
movers24h.shortDescription: An Improper Authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy under SSL VPN web portal allows an unauthenticated attacker to modify the password.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Unspecified vulnerability allows for an authenticated user to escalate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to various admin endpoints.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Group Policy Preferences Password Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Active Directory contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it distributes passwords that are configured using Group Policy preferences. An authenticated attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could decrypt the passwords and use them to elevate privileges on the domain.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Netlogon Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft's Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run a specially crafted application on a device on the network. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of Zerologon.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller & Manager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to write arbitrary files as system authority.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apache ActiveMQ Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiClient EMS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow building public flows without requiring authentication.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: n8n Improper Control of Dynamically-Managed Code Resources Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: n8n contains an improper control of dynamically managed code resources vulnerability in its workflow expression evaluation system that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller, formerly SD-WAN vSmart, and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, formerly SD-WAN vManage, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system. This vulnerability exists because the peering authentication mechanism in an affected system is not working properly. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted requests to an affected system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to log in to an affected Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller as an internal, high-privileged, non-root user account. Using this account, the attacker could access NETCONF, which would then allow the attacker to manipulate network configuration for the SD-WAN fabric.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RoundCube Webmail Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RoundCube Webmail contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows remote code execution by authenticated users because the _from parameter in a URL is not validated in program/actions/settings/upload.php.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) OneView contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Oracle Fusion Middleware Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Oracle Fusion Middleware contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to take over Identity Manager.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiWeb Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiWeb contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute administrative commands on the system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: CWP Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via shell metacharacters in the t_total parameter in a filemanager changePerm request. A valid non-root username must be known.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Kentico Xperience CMS Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Kentico Xperience CMS contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an attacker to control administrative objects.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Experience Manager Forms Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Experience Manager Forms in JEE contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GNU Bash OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: GNU Bash contains an OS command injection vulnerability which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a crafted environment.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiWeb SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiWeb contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized SQL code or commands via crafted HTTP or HTTPs requests.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: PHPMailer Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: PHPMailer contains a command injection vulnerability because it fails to sanitize user-supplied input. Specifically, this issue affects the 'mail()' function of 'class.phpmailer.php' script. An attacker can exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code within the context of the application. Failed exploit attempts will result in a denial-of-service condition.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Erlang Erlang/OTP SSH server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability. This could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands without valid credentials, potentially leading to unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). By exploiting a flaw in how SSH protocol messages are handled, a malicious actor could gain unauthorized access to affected systems. This vulnerability could affect various products that implement Erlang/OTP SSH server, including—but not limited to—Cisco, NetApp, and SUSE.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ASUS Routers Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ASUS Lyra Mini and ASUS GT-AC2900 devices contain an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access to the administrative interface. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apache Tomcat Path Equivalence Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apache Tomcat contains a path equivalence vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code, disclose information, or inject malicious content via a partial PUT request. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2026‑34486.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Progress WhatsUp Gold Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Progress WhatsUp Gold contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor Local File Inclusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create users with read-write privileges (including administrator).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Aviatrix Controllers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Aviatrix Controllers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Shell metacharacters can be sent to /v1/api in cloud_type for list_flightpath_destination_instances, or src_cloud_type for flightpath_connection_test.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks Expedition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary OS commands as root in Expedition, resulting in disclosure of usernames, cleartext passwords, device configurations, and device API keys of PAN-OS firewalls.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Nostromo nhttpd Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Nostromo nhttpd contains a directory traversal vulnerability in the http_verify() function in a non-chrooted nhttpd server allowing for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DSL-2760U Gateway Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the D-Link DSL-2760U gateway, allowing remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Polkit Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Red Hat Polkit contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability through the bypassing of credential checks for D-Bus requests, allowing for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins User Interface (UI) Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Jenkins User Interface (UI) contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users to see the names of jobs and builds otherwise inaccessible to them on the "Fingerprints" pages.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Excel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that can be exploited when a specially crafted Excel file is opened. This malicious file could be delivered as an email attachment or hosted on a malicious website. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability by creating a specially crafted Excel file, which, when opened, allowing an attacker to execute remote code on the affected system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Edge Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Chakra JavaScript scripting engine in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Storing Passwords in a Recoverable Format Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a storing passwords in a recoverable format vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to gain DCA user privileges by accessing a credential file for the DCA user on the filesystem as a low-privileged user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms Invoker Servlet does not require authentication, allowing for remote code execution via a HTTP or HTTPS request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: NETGEAR DGN2200 Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: dnslookup.cgi on NETGEAR DGN2200 devices with firmware through 10.0.0.50 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for local privilege escalation.

movers7d.product: IOS, IOS XR, and IOS XE
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS, IOS XR, and IOS XE IKEv1 Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco IOS, IOS XR, and IOS XE contain insufficient condition checks in the part of the code that handles Internet Key Exchange version 1 (IKEv1) security negotiation requests. contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the Internet Key Exchange version 1 (IKEv1) that could allow an attacker to retrieve memory contents. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to retrieve memory contents, which can lead to information disclosure.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability that can allow a malicious app to bypass signature validation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a Word document with a crafted tag containing an invalid length field.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player and AIR Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player and Adobe AIR allows attackers to execute code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: JScript in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server contain a SSRF vulnerability due to improper validation of URLs in a vCenter Server plugin. This allows for information disclosure.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SAM Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: If a Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) shadow copy of the system drive is available, users can read the SAM file which would allow any user to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Nagios XI OS Command Injection
movers7d.shortDescription: Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Apache HTTP Server, with MPM event, worker or prefork, code executing in less-privileged child processes or threads (including scripts executed by an in-process scripting interpreter) could execute code with the privileges of the parent process (usually root) by manipulating the scoreboard.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft MSHTML Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft MSHTML engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution vulnerability.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability during web page generation in Outlook Web Access and when certain interaction conditions are met, arbitrary JavaScript can be executed in the browser context.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway, Secure Email, AsyncOS Software, and Web Manager appliances contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows threat actors to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system of an affected appliance.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: OpenPLC ScadaBR Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: OpenPLC ScadaBR contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to upload and execute arbitrary JSP files via view_edit.shtm.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sitecore Multiple Products Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sitecore Experience Manager (XM), Experience Platform (XP), Experience Commerce (XC), and Managed Cloud contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability involving the use of default machine keys. This flaw allows attackers to exploit exposed ASP.NET machine keys to achieve remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel PIE Stack Buffer Corruption Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Linux kernel contains a position-independent executable (PIE) stack buffer corruption vulnerability in load_elf_ binary() that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: FXC AE1021, AE1021PE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: FXC AE1021 and AE1021PE contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Juniper Junos OS EX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to installAppPackage.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Service Location Protocol (SLP) Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Service Location Protocol (SLP) contains a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to register services and use spoofed UDP traffic to conduct a denial-of-service (DoS) attack with a significant amplification factor.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution in the context of the current user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium libvpx Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium libvpx contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in vp8 encoding that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could impact web browsers using libvpx, including but not limited to Google Chrome.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Roundcube Webmail SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Roundcube Webmail is vulnerable to SQL injection via search or search_params.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Certificate Dialog Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Certificate Dialog contains a privilege escalation vulnerability, allowing attackers to run processes in an elevated context.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing for remote code execution when performing a password change or reset.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver for Windows Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Intel ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows IQVW32.sys and IQVW64.sys contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service (DoS).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: TIBCO JasperReports Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: TIBCO JasperReports Server contain a vulnerability which may allow any authenticated user read-only access to the contents of the web application, including key configuration files.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

newest.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Unspecified Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability which could allow a local user to gain privileged access or cause a denial of service on the system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

newest.product: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
newest.vulnerabilityName: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

newest.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Weak Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.
